name: API for custom sandbox base images, built on top of the VM sandbox base via an image-builder agent
description: API for custom sandbox base images, built on top of the VM sandbox base via an image-builder agent API for custom sandbox base images, built on top of the VM sandbox base via an image-builder agent. DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/sandbox_custom_images/{id}/
context:
DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}/sandbox_custom_images/{id}/
API for custom sandbox base images, built on top of the VM sandbox base via an image-builder agent. Custom images only run on the Modal VM runtime, so every action is gated on the `tasks-modal-vm-sandbox` flag (org-enabled with `user_created` in its origin_products payload).
Required: id (path); project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
